question: What are the top 5 products by total quantity sold in completed orders? Return columns name and total_quantity, ordered by total_quantity descending, then name ascending to break ties.

gold.sql: SELECT p.name AS name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, p.name ASC LIMIT 5
